DA_MT_has_mil_0 = {   # the War Wizard's price
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MT_has_mil_0_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes mil_power = 100 }
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes mil_power = 80 }
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes mil_power = 60 }
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes mil_power = 40 }
		}
	}
}
DA_MT_has_mil_20 = {   # the War Wizard's price and 20
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MT_has_mil_20_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes mil_power = 120 }
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes mil_power = 100 }
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes mil_power = 80 }
			AND = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes mil_power = 60 }
		}
	}
}

	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MT_has_element_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes any_owned_province = { DA_MT_is_9 = yes } }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes any_owned_province = { DA_MT_is_10 = yes } }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes any_owned_province = { DA_MT_is_11 = yes } }
			AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Air = yes any_owned_province = { DA_MT_is_12 = yes } }
		}
	}
}
